comment: No source is published. The knob figures are delay 0.0015 to 2 seconds with a default of 0.15, gate 0.001 to 1 second with a default of 0.001, both shown in ms by a display multiplier of 1000. So the gate knob comes up at its own minimum, a 1ms pulse. Each of the two CV jacks is a multiplier on its knob through exp2f, so a patched cable resting at 0V leaves the knob alone; the delay result is capped at 5 seconds and the gate at 5 seconds with a 1ms floor, both above what the knobs alone can reach. The write-back is a maximum rather than an assignment, which is why a retrigger cannot shorten a delay already in progress. The panel prints DLAY and TIME beside the jack-and-knob pairs and TRIG twice, once on the input and once on the output; the maker's tooltips for the second pair are Gate time on the knob and Gate length on the jack. Panel lettering came from https://library.vcvrack.com/screenshots/400/DigitalAtavism/DTrig.png; the plugin ships no panel SVG.
